scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names api,web "npm run dev --workspace=apps/api" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/web && npm run typecheck --workspace=e2e
scripts.codegen: npm run codegen --workspace=apps/api && npm run codegen --workspace=apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=apps/api && npm run test --workspace=apps/web && vitest run --config vitest.config.js
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run codegen && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
